classes.name: water_spill
classes.description: Clear or translucent liquid puddle posing immediate pedestrian slip-and-fall risk.

classes.name: oil_spill
classes.description: Viscous, dark, or greasy hydrocarbon liquid on walking surface posing severe slip hazard.

classes.name: broken_glass
classes.description: Shattered glass shards, fragments, or sharp transparent debris on floor.

classes.name: obstacle
classes.description: Loose objects, boxes, pallets, cables, or dropped materials causing tripping hazards.

background_condition.name: clean_floor
background_condition.description: Verified dry, clean walking surface with no hazard bounding boxes to train false-positive suppression.
